api.fromString: string|null -> zero-initialized QString; over30 UTF8 bytes throws before writes
api.constructInto: writes existing validated32-byte QString; empty/null clears whole storage; nonempty retains unused tail
api.fromBytes: copies raw32 bytes; byteCount>30 refused as corrupt/out-of-bounds
api.toString_length: valid UTF8 only; malformed raw UTF8 decoding explicitly refused
api.equals_getHashCode: typed byte equality/int32 hash including malformed payload bytes; ignores tail
api.compareOrdinal: equal common prefix returns native byte-count difference; mismatch requires host.compareBytes(xPrefix,yPrefix,minCount) returning native nonzero int32
api.isFindActorKey_findActor: empty rejects before host calls; otherwise host.containsKey(q), host.getValue(q), host.getActor(entityRef). Does not scan objects or implement registration.
